results.title: Oil firms fail to invest despite strong profits – NESG
results.snippet: The report said, “Nigeria’s petroleum exports are shifting from crude towards refined products, consistent with the Dangote refinery reaching full operation. That weakness stands out in such a capital-intensive sector.
